assessment: The Src tyrosine kinase controls cancer-critical protein glycosylation through Golgi to ER relocation of a subset of Golgi enzymes, GALNTs, from the Golgi to the ER. The authors show here that Src induces the formation of tubular transport carriers containing GALNTs by phosphorylating GBF1 and promoting its binding to Arf1. This study presents some of the first clues to the molecular events underlying Src-regulated relocalization of glycosyltransferases.
